# weight-loss.ca

> Canada's independent resource for GLP-1 weight loss medications, generic semaglutide pricing, and evidence-based weight management information. Updated weekly with real pharmacy prices and Health Canada approvals.

## What this site covers

- **Generic semaglutide in Canada** — pricing, availability, provincial drug plan coverage, telehealth options
- **GLP-1 medication reviews** — Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Saxenda, Contrave (Canadian pricing in CAD)
- **Weight loss clinic directories** — Canadian cities (Calgary, Toronto, Vancouver, Edmonton, Montreal)
- **How-to guides** — practical weight loss and medication access guides for Canadians
- **News tracker** — daily feed of semaglutide and GLP-1 news from Canadian sources

## Key facts (as of June 2026)

- Generic semaglutide approved in Canada: Apo-Semaglutide (Apotex, May 2026) and Dr. Reddy's Semaglutide Injection (April 2026)
- Canada is the first G7 country to approve generic semaglutide
- Generic semaglutide retail price: $88–$114/month (vs $250–$500 for brand-name Ozempic)
- Cheapest all-in option (consultation + medication + delivery): PocketPills at $114/month
- Provincial drug plans cover generic semaglutide for Type 2 diabetes only — not weight loss
- 8+ additional generic submissions under Health Canada review; prices projected to fall to $70–$90/month with 3+ generics

## About

weight-loss.ca is an independent Canadian health publication. All drug pricing is sourced from pharmacy price checks and telehealth provider listings. Content is updated weekly. Not affiliated with any pharmaceutical manufacturer, pharmacy, or telehealth provider.
